9. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
Any dispute, controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, including its
interpretation, meaning, scope or validity, termination or breach shall be referred to and resolved
by arbitration, administered electronically, by a sole arbitrator to be appointed by any online
dispute resolution forums ("ODR"). The arbitral institution designated as ODR shall conduct the
proceedings in accordance with its rules. The seat of arbitration shall be Pune. The language of the
arbitration shall be English. The award shall be final and binding on the Parties.
